issues.concern: The explanation states 'The second day of the work week,' which is culturally specific and not universally true (e.g., in some cultures, Monday is the first day of the work week, making Tuesday the second, but in others, Sunday is the first day of the week, making Tuesday the third).
issues.suggestion: Remove 'The second day of the work week.' or rephrase to be more inclusive, e.g., 'Often considered the second day of the work week.'
